episodes.synopsis: Lupin recruits technology whiz Ami to hack a security system she designed so they can steal a wealth of digital currency from the website Marco Polo, but after the heist, they find Zenigata hot on their heels thanks to tips from social media.
episodes.title: The Girl in the Twin Towers

episodes.synopsis: Marco Polo's new social media game encourages the populace to report sightings of Lupin, making it almost impossible for him to hide from the police; Lupin tries to steal a plane.
episodes.title: The Lupin Game

episodes.synopsis: Marco Polo's new game motivates the world's most notorious assassins to converge on Lupin.
episodes.title: The Killers Gather in the Wasteland

episodes.synopsis: Zenigata comes to the rescue and escapes with Lupin and Ami, but when their car comes under attack, the group must cross the desert on foot.
episodes.title: Zenigata's Pride and the Desert Dust

episodes.synopsis: In the wake of Lupin's murder, Ami goes to live with Zenigata; word from Goemon motivates Ami to confront the Marco Polo executives.
episodes.title: A Crook's Resolve

episodes.synopsis: The Greater Tokyo Bank installs a new high-tech safe and Lupin can't resist taking a crack at it.
episodes.title: Lupin vs the Smart Safe

episodes.synopsis: A retired art forger hires Lupin to steal his grandchild's painting, which resembles a work by Picasso, from Mr. B, the millionaire who bought it.
episodes.title: His Name Is Albert

episodes.synopsis: Lupin tries to learn more about the black notebook he acquired while meeting a man claiming to be Gaston's best friend; the man helps Lupin escape when the authorities suddenly appear.
episodes.title: Who Has the Black Notebook?

episodes.synopsis: The assassin Jose manages to take the notebook from Lupin; Lupin discloses his past with Albert, his former partner, who broke away to enter politics.
episodes.title: The Man Who Abandoned "Lupin"

episodes.synopsis: Lupin, Jigen, Goemon and Albert launch an attack on Jose's compound to retrieve the notebook.
episodes.title: Thief and Thief

episodes.synopsis: Lupin gets involved in a car race while seeking a missing kingpin's hidden wealth in South America.
episodes.title: Get Pablo's Collection

episodes.synopsis: Goemon seeks out a bistro owner who recently inherited a fortune and decides to protect her from assassins amid the backdrop of a town-wide pop culture festival.
episodes.title: The Extravagance of Goemon Ishikawa XIII

episodes.synopsis: At a private school, Ami befriends a princess named Dolma, who possesses a piece of jewelry Lupin and Fujiko hope to get their hands on, but an armed takeover of the school puts everyone's lives in danger.
episodes.title: The Bow, the Princess, and the Terrorist

episodes.synopsis: Lupin and company travel to Padar to track down Princess Dolma and steal the Bloody Teardrop. Their plan is to depose the King and install Dolma as a puppet ruler.
episodes.title: How to Steal a Kingdom

episodes.synopsis: After Ami and Fujiko help an injured Lupin escape, Ami reconsiders Fujiko's motivation.
episodes.title: Her Relationship with Lupin

episodes.synopsis: The Shake Hands company enters Padar's civil war and the king issues a proclamation; Ami disguises herself as Dolma to help Lupin rescue the princess.
episodes.title: Let's Talk About First Loves

episodes.synopsis: Three years after a count's unsolved murder, his widow gathers three suspects together and asks Lupin to play the role of detective, but a blackout and further deaths compound the mystery.
episodes.title: Introducing Detective Jim Barnett III

episodes.synopsis: Tensions rise among the gang as they settle into their Riquewihr hideout to plan their next move.
episodes.title: Fujiko's Gift

episodes.synopsis: Lupin heads to Northern Africa in response to a challenge from the wealthy Zylberstein and Jigen accompanies him to face off against Zylberstein's sniper, Mirage.
episodes.title: A 7.62mm Mirage

episodes.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata goes on a crime spree in a remote Russian town, baffling Lupin and his gang.
episodes.title: Zenigata, Gentleman Thief

episodes.synopsis: A new people-tracking social media service complicates Lupin's attempt to rob a Vienna art museum.
episodes.title: An Outdated Master Thief

episodes.synopsis: Lupin and the gang race to the island headquarters of Shake Hands to rescue a kidnapped Fujiko.
episodes.title: Answer Me, Zantetsuken

episodes.synopsis: Ami reunites with her father, who believes his social media technology will help mankind; with Lupin and Goemon imprisoned, Jigen must operate alone.
episodes.title: Just Then, An Old Buddy Said Something

episodes.synopsis: Lupin erases his digital footprint while wreaking havoc on the world through Peoplelog, bringing the world's fury to bear on Shake Hands.
episodes.title: Viva Lupin III
